title: Code from Portuguese organisations on GitHub

provenance.by: sources/github-pt/collect.mjs (code, no model; run by data.b.dev@PrompTugal.dinis)
provenance.terms: GitHub's terms allow this use: reading public data through the API is permitted; excessive requests may be suspended; data must not be used for spam or to sell users' personal information. We read organisations' public repositories and releases only, collect no personal data, stay well under the rate limits, and keep each repository's own licence (or a link to its terms) on every item. Not reviewed by a person.

about: Public repositories and latest releases (last 3 per repository, for repositories pushed in the last 90 days) of 21 Portuguese organisations on GitHub, read through GitHub's official REST API. Each organisation was verified as Portuguese by hand (verified_how). Forks are left out. Descriptions are the repositories' own words, shortened to 200 characters, plain text, untrusted. Each item carries its own licence: the repository's licence where it declares one, otherwise a link to the repository, whose terms apply. No contributors, emails, user profiles or organisation members are collected. A signal of activity, not a ranking.
